## Current Behavior
`findImports` never returns for a `.tsx`/`.jsx` file with a 3 or 4 byte character (`…`, `→`, `€`, emoji) where swc expects a JSX attribute, such as `<B …>`. swc's JSX tag lexer emits an empty token at the same offset forever, so every project graph command hangs.

## Expected Behavior
`findImports` stops when the lexer emits two empty tokens at the same offset, logs it at debug level, and keeps the imports found before that point. swc's debug assertions are turned off in dev/test builds so the regression test reaches the same code path release builds take.
